name: kdump-tools

crash_dumps.rationale: Kernel crash dumps are forensic evidence written by kdump-tools after a panic.

storage.rationale: kdump-tools owns the host crash-dump directory on Linux.

description: kdump capture-kernel framework — captures full kernel crash dumps on panic to /var/crash for forensic analysis
installHint: Install kdump-tools and reboot after the crashkernel_reserve safeguard adds the crashkernel= parameter. Without crashkernel reserved, kdump cannot operate.
